name: cl_os_fvg15_fix40

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20, lens oside: the leader (cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1, the owner's 15-minute open-side FVG, gap >= 0.1 ATR, two a day) with ONE fixed bracket, 40-point stop and 40-point target, in place of the middle-candle stop. Cause: above the 09:30 open buyers are in control, so the newest up gap is buying that was left unfilled and gets defended on the way back, and the traders fading the open's side pay; one fixed bracket asks whether that edge is in the entry itself or only in the size of the middle candle, and it is the bracket a prop account and a blueprint card can carry.

entry.words: Above the 09:30 open: a limit at the near edge of the most recent 15-minute up fair value gap (gap at least 0.1 x ATR14 high); below the open: the most recent down gap. The same bracket every trade: stop 40 points, target 40 points (1:1). Up to two trades a day, one at a time; entries 09:30-15:00; flat 15:58.

taught: [owner, chat 2026-10-19] above the 09:30 open: longs on the most recent FVG; below: shorts
[owner, chat 2026-10-19] target 1:1 ('run the same rule at 1:1')
[Claude 2026-10-20, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] gaps at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high; two a day

[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] one fixed bracket, stop 40 / target 40 points, in place of the owner's middle-candle stop: 40 = the leader's stored middle-candle stop rounded (median 36.9, mean 43.0 points over its 1,268 build-day trades); a size read off the store, not a result
not_run: THE OWNER'S STOP: the middle candle's extreme is replaced by a fixed 40 points (this sheet's whole question). The family still skips a gap whose middle candle does not reach beyond the near edge, so the signals are the leader's.
THE CAP: two a day (one instance for the whole window).
GAP SIZE: at least 0.1 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars (the leader's).
SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on each 15-minute close, not tick by tick.
THE ENTRY: a limit at the gap's near edge; a newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order; an unfilled order is cancelled at 15:00.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
